verdict.rationale: Warehouse Sync documents SQL-based ingestion from customers' own Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery and Databricks warehouses, with an API and data mapping. Once that data is in mParticle, audiences can be connected to audience outputs for activation, so warehouse tables can feed activation without re-collecting events through SDKs. However, the documented flow copies warehouse data into mParticle rather than running natively on the warehouse, and the 'Composable Audiences' page appears only as a title with no described capability. Missing for 10: documented in-warehouse (zero-copy) audience and model definition, detail on Composable Audiences behavior, an end-to-end warehouse-to-destination activation walkthrough, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
